data.one_liner: A single Flutter widget for rendering Markdown, LaTeX equations, and HTML content.
data.what_it_does: Renders rich text content containing Markdown formatting, mathematical LaTeX expressions, and HTML elements in a unified widget. It includes robust parsing for streaming AI responses and protects currency symbols or code blocks from false-positive equation matching.
use_when: Building AI chat applications that stream markdown and math content
Displaying educational or documentation content with LaTeX equations
Rendering mixed HTML and Markdown text within Flutter
avoid_when: You only need standard plain text or basic Text widgets without markup
You require full enterprise-grade custom web-rendering engines outside of flutter_html capabilities
strengths: Streaming-safe parsing handles incomplete equations progressively
Robust edge case handling protects code blocks and currency values from LaTeX parsing
Decoupled architecture separates parsing logic from UI rendering
weaknesses: Relies on external packages like flutter_html and flutter_math_fork for underlying rendering
data.minimal_example:
RichMarkdownView(
  data: '# Hello, Rich Markdown!\n\nInline equation: \\(E = mc^2\\)',
  type: ContentType.markdown,
)
